### Kind of change

Tick **exactly one**. Each kind is reviewed differently, so mixing them in one PR makes the diff difficult to review ([why](https://github.com/boostorg/graph/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#one-kind-of-change-per-pr)).

- [ ] Reformat (layout only, no token added or removed)
- [ ] Refactor (no observable behavior change)
- [ ] Behavior change (observable to users of the library)
- [ ] No code change (documentation, build, CI, or tooling)
